classification.difficultyReason: Locate each image vertex halfway from the given centre to its original vertex and join them, directly applying the taught reduction construction.

content.prompt: Scale the triangle below by a factor of $\frac{1}{2}$ using $O$ as the centre of enlargement.

spec.description: Eight-column, six-row grid with the centre O and a right-pointing triangle. A blank-grid template cannot retain the given triangle and labelled point.
spec.mathematics: Top-left origin with downward-positive y: O=(1,3); triangle vertices (5,1), (7,3), (5,5).
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original triangle and O are visible.

answer.short: The image vertices are 2 squares right and 1 square up from $O$, 3 squares right from $O$, and 2 squares right and 1 square down from $O$.
answer.worked: Draw rays from $O$ through each vertex. Place each image vertex halfway along its ray, so $OP'=\frac{1}{2}OP$. The image vertices are 2 squares right and 1 square up from $O$, 3 squares right from $O$, and 2 squares right and 1 square down from $O$. Join them.

spec.mathematics: Image vertices (3,2), (4,3), (3,4), obtained by halving each displacement from O=(1,3).
